Print the Operating Characteristics of the BOIN12 Design Across Scenarios

Source: R/print.boin12_oc_multi.R
print.boin12_oc_multi.Rd

Display the summary produced by sim_boin12_multi as one table with a block of rows per scenario.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'boin12_oc_multi'
print(
  x,
  digits = 1,
  percent = FALSE,
  kable = FALSE,
  kable_format = "pipe",
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An object of class boin12_oc_multi.

digits

Integer scalar. Number of decimal places. Defaults to 1.

percent

Logical scalar. Express the average numbers of patients, DLTs and responses at each dose as percentages of the trial totals. Defaults to FALSE.

kable

Logical scalar. Print the table with knitr::kable(), for use in R Markdown. Defaults to FALSE.

kable_format

Character scalar. Format passed to knitr::kable(). Defaults to "pipe".

...

Not used.

Value

x, invisibly.

Examples

scenarios <- list(
  "Plateau" = list(p_true = c(0.05, 0.12, 0.27, 0.35, 0.50),
                   p_resp = c(0.20, 0.35, 0.36, 0.37, 0.38)),
  "Increasing" = list(p_true = c(0.05, 0.12, 0.27, 0.35, 0.50),
                      p_resp = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.30, 0.60, 0.60))
)
oc <- sim_boin12_multi(
  target = 0.35, target_resp = 0.25, scenarios = scenarios,
  n_cohort = 12, cohort_size = 3, n_trials = 200, seed = 1
)
print(oc, percent = TRUE)
